quiz.question_id: Tanpa `t.Helper()`, baris kegagalan biasanya menunjuk ke mana?
quiz.question_en: Without `t.Helper()`, where does the failure line usually point?
options_id: Ke baris di dalam helper yang memanggil `t.Errorf` atau `t.Fatal`
options_en: To the line inside the helper that calls `t.Errorf` or `t.Fatal`

quiz.question_id: Apa manfaat utama mengekstrak assertion berulang ke helper function?
quiz.question_en: What is the main benefit of extracting repeated assertions into helper functions?
options_id: Membuat helper berjalan otomatis di semua test
Mengurangi duplikasi dan menjaga test utama fokus pada intent
options_en: It makes helpers run automatically in every test
It reduces duplication and keeps the main test focused on intent
It forces all tests to become parallel

quiz.question_id: `AssertEqual` pada lesson memakai `reflect.DeepEqual` terutama untuk apa?
quiz.question_en: Why does `AssertEqual` in the lesson mainly use `reflect.DeepEqual`?
options_id: Agar perbandingan bisa bekerja pada value kompleks seperti slice, map, atau struct
Agar semua comparison menjadi constant time
options_en: So comparisons can work on complex values like slices, maps, or structs
So every comparison becomes constant time
So the helper can be called without `t.Helper()`
So error messages are translated automatically

options_id: Karena setelah error tak terduga, assertion berikutnya sering tidak valid lagi
Karena helper harus selalu menghentikan seluruh package test
options_en: Because after an unexpected error, later assertions are often no longer valid
Because helpers must always stop the entire package test

quiz.question_en: What does `AssertError(t, err)` do if `err` turns out to be `nil`?
options_id: Memanggil `t.Fatal` karena error diharapkan tetapi tidak ada
options_en: It logs a message and continues
It calls `t.Fatal` because an error was expected but none was present

quiz.question_id: Urutan yang benar dalam `TestMain` pada lesson adalah...
quiz.question_en: What is the correct order in the lesson's `TestMain`?

quiz.question_id: Mengapa return value dari `m.Run()` disimpan lalu diteruskan ke `os.Exit(code)` setelah teardown?
quiz.question_en: Why is the return value of `m.Run()` stored and then passed to `os.Exit(code)` after teardown?
options_id: Agar hasil pass/fail test package tetap menjadi exit status proses
Agar test bisa dijalankan dua kali
options_en: So the package test pass/fail result remains the process exit status
So the tests can be run twice

options_id: Membersihkan output terminal dari log test
Menjadwalkan fungsi cleanup yang dijalankan saat test atau subtest selesai
options_en: Cleaning terminal output from test logs
Scheduling a cleanup function to run when the test or subtest finishes

quiz.question_id: Dalam pembagian tanggung jawab, mana yang paling cocok menjadi helper dan bukan `TestMain`?
quiz.question_en: In terms of responsibilities, which belongs in a helper rather than in `TestMain`?
options_id: Setup database sekali untuk seluruh package
options_en: Setting up the database once for the whole package

quiz.question_id: Jika helper lupa memanggil `t.Helper()`, apa kerugian debugging yang paling nyata?
quiz.question_en: If a helper forgets to call `t.Helper()`, what is the most visible debugging cost?
options_id: Test tidak akan terdeteksi oleh `go test`
Stack trace dan line number mengarah ke abstraksi helper, bukan lokasi pemanggilan yang gagal
options_en: The test will not be discovered by `go test`
The stack trace and line number point at the helper abstraction, not the failing call site
